tasks.description: Produce a NEW engineering doc at docs/ep2-share-purchase-readiness.md (create docs/ if needed). This is a DESIGN/PLANNING deliverable ONLY — write NO application code, edit NO existing contract/model/requirements file, and do NOT implement any 06 posting rule (06 is do-not-implement pending controller ratification U1). Your job is to make the eventual EP-2 build a fast, low-risk fill-in by inventorying what exists and precisely scoping what's left, split by ratification gate. READ (read-only sources; cite each material claim as [VERIFIED: file:line] or [UNVERIFIED]): backend/openapi/paths/ep2-shares.yaml + backend/openapi/schemas/ep2-shares.yaml (the 4 operations purchaseMembershipShare/getSharePurchaseStatus/listMyShares/getShareRegistry — request/response schemas, declared status codes, Idempotency-Key); backend/app/models/ledger.py (Account, Transaction, LedgerEntry) and backend/app/models/membership.py (MembershipShare, Member status enum); the EP-2 acceptance criteria in idea-lab/final_requirements/03_acceptance_criteria.md (EP-2, ~16 scenarios — amount==par 422 AMOUNT_MISMATCH, payment-failure keeps PENDING_PAYMENT, illegal DEC-4 transitions rejected, suspended blocked 403 no status leakage, closure preconditions); idea-lab/final_requirements/06_ledger_addendum.md §4.1 (the SHARE_SUBSCRIPTION posting rule: collection Dr 1010 Payment-Processor Clearing / Cr Member SHARE; remittance split Dr 1000 FBO + 5400 Processing Fees / Cr 1010; net-of-fees remittance) and invariant L-4 (count(ISSUED shares) × par_value = balance(3000)); DEC-4 (status machine) and DEC-11 (10,000₮ par) in 01 §6; the money non-negotiables in CLAUDE.md (integer minor units, Idempotency-Key mandatory on money-movement POST, three-part names, no float). Also check backend/app/api/routers/ and backend/app/services/ to confirm there is NO existing share-purchase wiring, and note the EP-1 promotion pattern (repositories->services->routers, router owns the commit) the eventual build should mirror. DELIVER, in the doc: (1) Inventory — a table of what EXISTS (contract ops, models, status enum, EP-1 patterns) with file:line evidence; (2) US-2.1 AC map — each 03 EP-2 scenario -> the component that must satisfy it -> exists? / to-build; (3) the exact 06 SHARE_SUBSCRIPTION posting rule reproduced with account numbers + the L-4 invariant, labelled 'ratification-gated, do not implement until U1'; (4) THE SPLIT — a two-column list: RATIFICATION-INDEPENDENT (buildable now: amount==configured-par validation -> 422 AMOUNT_MISMATCH; Idempotency-Key handling; DEC-4 status-transition guard incl. rejecting illegal transitions; suspended-member 403 with no status leakage; payment initiation behind a PORT+MOCK like the eKYC pattern; getSharePurchaseStatus polling; listMyShares/getShareRegistry reads) vs LEDGER-GATED (needs U1: the SHARE_SUBSCRIPTION double-entry posting, PENDING_PAYMENT->ACTIVE activation on settlement, L-4 enforcement, share registry point-in-time snapshot if it depends on ledger balances) — and for each ratification-independent item name the file it would live in; (5) Gaps/risks — any contract<->model<->AC<->06 inconsistency you find (e.g. a status code an AC needs but the contract doesn't declare; a field mismatch; a posting account not in ledger.py's seed), each as a concrete finding; (6) a build sequence for when U1 lands. Do NOT invent facts to fill gaps — an honest 'could not verify / not found' is correct. Run .softhouse/verify-docs.sh at the end and confirm it does not regress (a docs/ file is outside its scanned set, so it should be unaffected). Scope: create ONLY docs/ep2-share-purchase-readiness.md.
